headline: More Than a Week Without Customers Able to Withdraw Money, Amar Bank Speaks Up
summary: PT Bank Amar Indonesia (AMAR) commented on a service disruption at the digital bank that lasted about a week and left customers unable to withdraw funds.
why: Amar Bank is a listed Indonesian digital bank, and service outages can affect depositor confidence.
original_headline: Lebih dari Seminggu Nasabah Gak Bisa Tarik Uang, Amar Bank Buka Suara
